force_import_shadow_direction.meaning: When a document force-imports a name (`namespace import -force ns::*`) and the workspace export index says a sibling document exports that name, LSP providers (definition, signature, call hierarchy, rename and the other original-name providers) give no answer for that name in the shadowed direction. Neither the local definition nor the sibling's export is proven, because cross-document execution order stays conditional (decision 2026-10-17T20:30Z export_order) and the document is otherwise analysed as a fresh interpreter (decision 2026-10-19T14:20Z).
force_import_shadow_direction.tests: rust/tcl-lsp-core force_import_shadow_consumers: the 8 shadowed-direction tests change to expect abstention, each citing this decision; the tests that pass today keep their assertions.
